name: [Equip] RUM has gone quiet (no real sessions in 48h)
message:
Not one real visitor session reached Datadog in two days.

The site gets a few real sessions every day, so two silent days almost certainly means the telemetry broke, not that nobody came. Since 2026-09-28 the browser SDK sends through our own origin — `/_e/*`, rewritten in `frontend/vercel.json` to `browser-intake-us5-datadoghq.com` — and automation never starts RUM at all (`isAutomatedVisitor` in `frontend/src/lib/datadog.ts`). Either change can silence RUM with nothing else failing.

Check, in order:
1. `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://equipbible.com/_e/api/v2/rum` — expect a 4xx JSON from Datadog. A 200 with HTML means the rewrite is gone and every batch is landing on index.html.
2. Open the site in a normal browser, DevTools → Network, filter `_e` — batches should answer 202.
3. The Vercel env vars `VITE_DATADOG_APPLICATION_ID` / `VITE_DATADOG_CLIENT_TOKEN` on Production.

Why 48 hours: after automation stopped being recorded, a quiet day can genuinely have zero visitors; two cannot, at current traffic.
